_note_component_types: HONEST SHIPPED NUMBER = 8 (kept; NO raise). bg-elegance 2026-08-10 assessed the gauge's reported 14 for the MONO ship config: it is INFLATED, not real. The gauge globs ALL components/*.csv and counts distinct `type`-column values; the 6 excess types (meat/noodles/pearls/rice/seafood/tea) come ONLY from the PARKED, flag-gated split-taxonomy files (ingredients-split.csv, vendors-split.csv — SPLIT_TAXONOMY default OFF, out of scope for the shipping budget per CD decision 1A). The mono ship files yield exactly 8 distinct `type` values (booking, signature, the 4 region tags, sugar, veg) = AT cap. So component_types is WITHIN the shipping budget; the gauge will keep printing 14/8 as a measurement artifact until the split CSVs are removed or the gauge is scoped to non-split files (a tools/ change, out of bg-elegance scope). NOTE: this proxy reads ingredient/region CSV categories, not physical component variety (meeples/die/track/tokens/boards live in tokens.csv with no `type` value and are not measured here) — so it neither over- nor under-counts the physical box; 8 is the honest gauge value for the shipped data.
